members.member: The pool of sounds to play. If more than one is set, a random entry is picked each time [method play] is called.
The volume of the sound, as a linear multiplier. 1.0 is unchanged, 0.0 is silent.
The playback speed and pitch of the sound, as a multiplier. 1.0 is unchanged.
Random pitch variation applied on top of [member pitch] each time the sound plays, as a ratio. 1.0 means no variation.
Random volume variation applied on top of [member gain] each time the sound plays, in decibels. 0.0 means no variation.
If [code]true[/code] and [member streams] has more than one entry, the same entry is never picked twice in a row.
If [code]true[/code], the sound restarts automatically when it finishes playing.
If [code]true[/code], playback starts automatically when the scene loads.
